page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top with page number at top left. Below it, the Latin dating line in full width. Then a signature flourish on the left with two italic lines to its right, and a name line below. Then the German address heading and the sender's title in larger type. Then the German letter in one text column, running to the foot of the page.

main_text.p: Datum in Civitate nostra Imperiali Augusta, die xii. Maii, Anno Domini M. D. XV. Regni nostri Romani tricesimo.

head.bl: Dem Ehrsamen gelehrten/unserm Rathunnd deß Reichs lieben getreuen/ Bilibalden Pirckeymer.
Maximilian von Gottes Gnaden erwel-ter Römischer Keyser/&c.

p.bl: Ehrsamer gelehrter/lieber getreuer. Wir ha-ben den Triumphwagen mit sampt der Ex-position/den du uns zu unterthenigem gefallen/ zur zier unsers Triumphs gestellt/ und bey Zeiger diß Briefs zugesendet hast/empfangen/den auch notturfftig überse-hen/ und tragen an solchem deinem fleiß und erbieten sonders gnedig wolgefal-len/ sein auch der meinung/ inn kurtz ein andere arbeit

page.notes: The signature flourish on the left is a handwritten monogram; it is not printed text and is not transcribed. The page number reads as "246" in old figures; the last digit is uncertain. Fraktur and roman mixed: the German letter and headings are black letter. The running head and the paragraph ending "arbeit" run on to the next page.
